runs///summary.yaml
run_id: 2026-07-31-opus
judges: # per-judge aggregate
:
mean / pass_rate
stability: {...} # if samples>1
per_case: # value + rationale
case-001-slug:
: {value: true, rationale}
: {value: 4, rationale}
run_metrics: # cost_per_turn_usd,
# cache_hit_rate
pairwise: # only if --baseline
wins_a / wins_b / ties
